notes.title: Patch 1.9 – Resurrection and Refinement
notes.content: [p][b]Core Gameplay Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new respawn system, allowing players a second chance to survive and continue the experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved health system for more balanced and engaging gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game progression issues to ensure a consistent and fair flow throughout the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]AI and Challenge Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enhanced AI behavior for smarter, more challenging enemy encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Refined, added, and improved jumpscares to increase suspense and immersion.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quality of Life and UI:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Upgraded GPS system for clearer and easier navigation between objectives.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved location design to provide better understanding of the environment and objectives.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Technical Enhancements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimizations for improved performance and overall stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced localization with clearer text and better font rendering to support a wider audience.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple bug fixes and hotfixes to address reported issues and improve gameplay smoothness.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Additional Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Numerous smaller tweaks and adjustments aimed at polishing the game experience further.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.8 – Fight or Die
notes.content: [h1][b]Here’s what’s new in Patch 1.8:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]AI enemies can now attack you[/b] – it’s no longer just about hiding.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Health system implemented[/b] – manage your survival carefully.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jumpscares re-edited[/b] for better timing and impact.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization improvements[/b] – updated fonts and corrected text for a smoother experience across all supported languages.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Game progression fixed[/b] – you can no longer finish the game earlier than intended.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lighting overhaul[/b] – environments now look more dynamic and atmospheric.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overall optimization[/b] – improved performance across systems.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Major bug fixes and hotfixes[/b] – including critical issues reported by players.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.7 Patch -
notes.content: [h1][b]What’s new in this update:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Added a new location[/b] to explore, expanding the game world.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Extended the gameplay with new objectives and challenges.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Now you need to collect 4 dolls instead of 3—making survival even harder.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added 2 new random events to keep each playthrough unpredictable.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added 3 new languages: German, Russian, and Italian.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed AI locomotion for smoother and more realistic enemy movement.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimization and bug fixes to improve stability and performance.[/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.6
notes.content: [p][b]This update brings a major overhaul to many aspects of the game:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]A reworked introduction[/b]—now more immersive and engaging from the very first moments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jumpscares completely rebuilt from scratch[/b] for better pacing and impact.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.6[/b] for enhanced visuals and smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New objectives and tasks[/b] to expand the gameplay experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]GPS system added[/b]—locations and objectives are now clearly marked to guide you through the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Settings menu rework[/b] for better customization and control.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimization and bug fixes[/b] to improve performance and stability.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Wail - Patch 1.6
notes.content: [p][b]In this update, we’ve made major improvements to the game:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]A new, more immersive introduction[/b] to draw you deeper into the story from the start.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Completely reworked jumpscares[/b]—built from scratch for better timing and intensity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.6[/b] for better visuals, performance, and smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More objectives and tasks[/b] to keep the experience engaging and varied.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New GPS guidance system[/b]—locations are now displayed directly on your in-game GPS, so you always know where to go next.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overall optimization[/b] to improve performance and make the game run more smoothly.[/p][/*][/list]
